mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT source_id FROM t_ai_task WHERE source_id IN #{id} AND record_type = 'INVOCATION' AND skill_code = 'cluster_assisted_decision' AND (task_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING') OR (task_status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_expires_at > NOW(3))) ORDER BY source_id

SELECT id, task_status, input_snapshot, output_snapshot, lease_holder FROM t_ai_task WHERE task_key = #{taskKey} AND record_type = 'INVOCATION' AND skill_code = 'cluster_assisted_decision' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_ai_task(record_type, skill_code, prompt_version, skill_version_snapshot, prompt_sha256_snapshot, model_config_snapshot, source_id, task_key, task_status, input_snapshot, snapshot_retention_until, max_retries) VALUES('INVOCATION', 'cluster_assisted_decision', #{row.promptVersion}, #{row.skillVersion}, #{row.promptSha256}, JSON_OBJECT(), #{row.sourceId}, #{row.taskKey}, 'PENDING', CAST(#{row.inputSnapshot} AS JSON), DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 30 DAY), #{row.maxRetries})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, task_status = IF(retry_count >= max_retries, 'FAILED', 'RETRY_PENDING'), next_retry_at = IF(retry_count >= max_retries, NULL, NOW(3)), lease_holder = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, error_detail = 'CLUSTER_AI_LEASE_EXPIRED', completed_at = IF(retry_count >= max_retries, NOW(3), NULL) WHERE record_type = 'INVOCATION' AND skill_code = 'cluster_assisted_decision' AND task_status = 'PROCESSING' AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type = 'INVOCATION' AND skill_code = 'cluster_assisted_decision' AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status = 'PROCESSING', lease_holder = #{holder}, lease_expires_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 3 MINUTE) WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'INVOCATION' AND skill_code = 'cluster_assisted_decision' AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_status, input_snapshot, output_snapshot, lease_holder FROM t_ai_task WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'INVOCATION' AND skill_code = 'cluster_assisted_decision'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status = 'COMPLETED', output_snapshot = CAST(#{row.outputSnapshot} AS JSON), model_name_snapshot = #{row.modelName}, provider_request_id = #{row.providerRequestId}, input_tokens = #{row.inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{row.outputTokens}, latency_ms = #{row.latencyMs}, estimated_cost_usd = #{row.estimatedCostUsd}, lease_holder = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = NOW(3), error_detail = NULL WHERE id = #{row.id} AND lease_holder = #{row.holder} AND task_status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE t_ai_task SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, task_status = IF(retry_count >= max_retries, 'FAILED', 'RETRY_PENDING'), next_retry_at = IF(retry_count >= max_retries, NULL, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL POW(2,retry_count) MINUTE)), lease_holder = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, error_detail = #{errorDetail}, completed_at = IF(retry_count >= max_retries, NOW(3), NULL) WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_holder = #{holder} AND task_status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_task(record_type, task_key, task_status, input_snapshot, output_snapshot, snapshot_retention_until, user_id, model_name_snapshot, completed_at) VALUES('CLUSTER_EVALUATION', #{row.taskKey}, #{row.taskStatus}, CAST(#{row.inputSnapshot} AS JSON), CAST(#{row.outputSnapshot} AS JSON), DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 365 DAY), #{row.actor}, #{row.model}, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_status, model_name_snapshot, output_snapshot, completed_at FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type = 'CLUSTER_EVALUATION' ORDER BY completed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
